protocol.scope: Old selected origins, frozen probability/threshold models; no fitting or model reselection
protocol.prediction: Complete six-step public link domain, inputs timestamp<=T only
protocol.scoring: Read eligible public TRAIN future observations only after full prediction; apply scoring mask after set decision
protocol.legacy_comparison: Deliberately reproduce old availability-filtered set decisions to quantify bias

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Observed TRAIN labels, not latent truth. Old nonempty/expected-set arms are domain-sensitive; pointwise threshold arms can be unchanged. Original choices retained for audit, no new calibrated model or formal submission. Full-domain inputs still use the approximate public-train event sampler.
